steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the event type from the default RFP to an auction.
Choose a reverse/buy auction template so the pricing sheet is rendered.
Add the product line item to the auction sheet.
Clear the first row's quantity to reproduce the blank-quantity case.
Verify the sheet does not retain the blank quantity as a valid cell value.
Verify the app reports the quantity validation error immediately after the blank value is entered.
Add the required QA vendor participant before attempting publication.
Press Publish Event and verify publishing is refused because the line-item quantity is invalid or missing.
